notes.title: A Bleaker Predicklement is out now!
notes.content:
Yes. We know. We've promised it earlier. But finally it happened. A Bleaker Predicklement is finally out on Steam. And during its first week it will be 20% off.

And now, after delaying the game over and over again, it is finally out. And we'd love to say thanks. Thanks for your patience. Thanks for your trust. Thanks for being such a great community!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/489930/Adventures_of_Bertram_Fiddle_Episode_2/] A Bleaker Predicklement on Steam[/url]

- Rumpus Animation
